newsitem.title: UK: European setback for BA alliance hopes - paper.
newsitem.headline: European setback for BA alliance hopes - paper.

text.p: British Airways' (BA) hopes of getting European approval for a proposed alliance with American Airlines have been hit after Transport Commissioner Neil Kinnock accepted that plans to sell off runway slots at Heathrow were illegal, The Independent newspaper reported on Friday.

Kinnock had previously maintained that European regulations probably did allow the practice but following further analysis, his department has concluded that its original interpretation was wrong, according to the Independent.
It said the shift is likely to strengthen the position of Competition Commissioner Karel van Miert, who has insisted that slot trading is contrary to European law and should be outlawed completely.
If the European Commission decides to outlaw slot-trading it could severely weaken BA's negotiating position as it attempts to clear regulatory hurdles for the deal in Britain, Europe and the U.S.
